description: This Java class, MultivaluedMapContextAdapter, implements the Map interface to provide a single-value view over a multi-value map, allowing it to be used as a standard map with single values.

classes.name: MultivaluedMapContextAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class providing a Map view over a MultiValuedMapContext, enabling single-value map operations.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of keys in the adaptee map.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the adaptee map is empty.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Checks if the specified key exists in the adaptee map.

methods.name: containsValue
methods.description: Checks if at least one value in the adaptee map matches the specified value.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the first value associated with the specified key.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Associates the specified value with the specified key in the adaptee map.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the value associated with the specified key.

methods.name: putAll
methods.description: Copies all mappings from the specified map into the adaptee.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all mappings from the adaptee.

methods.name: keySet
methods.description: Returns a set of all keys in the adaptee map.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a collection of the first values for each key in the adaptee map.

methods.name: entrySet
methods.description: Returns a set view of the mappings contained in the map.
